newsitem.title: UK: Hess awards N.Sea contract to Brown & Root.
newsitem.headline: Hess awards N.Sea contract to Brown & Root.

text.p: Amerada Hess Ltd said on Tuesday it awarded a contract to Brown & Root Energy Services to provide facilities for the South Arne development in the Danish sector of the North Sea.

The 1.8 billion Danish crown ($270 million) contract covers a 550,000 barrel concrete storage base and topsides capable of processing 50,000 barrels of oil and two million cubic metres of natural gas a day. It also includes a fully equipped accommodation module.
Construction will take place at two BARMAC yards in the north of Scotland -- the storage base will be built at Nigg and the topsides at Ardesier.
South Arne is expected to start pumping oil in mid-1999 at around 50,000 barrels per day and will also produce about 700 million cubic metres of gas a year.
